{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for converted customers
converted_df = df[df['converted'] == 1]

# Check for sentinel age (-1) in converted customers
print(f"Number of converted customers with age = -1: {(converted_df['customer_age'] == -1).sum()}")

# Compute mean age excluding sentinel values
valid_ages = converted_df[converted_df['customer_age'] != -1]['customer_age']
mean_age = valid_ages.mean()

print(f"Mean age of converted customers (excluding -1): {mean_age}")"}
